findings.passage: Commonsense policy reform to regulate guns has broad, bipartisan support. It’s long past time we stand up and do something.

findings.passage: As I begin my work in Congress to protect our communities and prevent gun violence, I strive to do so with Gabby’s light, and to carry the memory of those Arizonans lost in my heart.
